title: Verified external-to-swap regret reduction and correlated-equilibrium solver
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: A finite Cesaro/Markov reduction turns one external regret learner per recommendation into a quantitative swap-regret bound. Applied to the pinned regret-matching and regret-matching+ algorithm, the development proves an approximate correlated-equilibrium guarantee for actual simultaneous play, with an explicit finite stationarity term. A rational refinement and exact coordination run make the construction executable.

review.reason: Verified reduction from external to swap regret with an approximate correlated-equilibrium solver.
